		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(
				'Dim_Producto'[categoria], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal",
				'Dim_Producto'[nombre_producto], "IsDM1Total"
			),
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Dim_Tiempo'[anio], "IsGrandTotalColumnTotal"),
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Ventas_Totales", 'Fact_Ventas_Envios'[Ventas Totales]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			102,
			SUMMARIZE(
				__DS0Core,
				'Dim_Producto'[categoria],
				[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
				'Dim_Producto'[nombre_producto],
				[IsDM1Total]
			),
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			'Dim_Producto'[categoria],
			1,
			[IsDM1Total],
			0,
			'Dim_Producto'[nombre_producto],
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Dim_Tiempo'[anio], [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal])

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(102, __DS0SecondaryBase, [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal], 1, 'Dim_Tiempo'[anio], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0Core,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				[IsGrandTotalColumnTotal],
				ASC,
				'Dim_Tiempo'[anio],
				ASC
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreNoInstanceFiltersNoTotals = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core),
			AND(
				AND([IsGrandTotalRowTotal] = FALSE, [IsDM1Total] = FALSE),
				[IsGrandTotalColumnTotal] = FALSE
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0CoreNoInstanceFiltersNoTotals,
		"MinVentas_Totales", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Ventas_Totales]),
		"MaxVentas_Totales", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Ventas_Totales])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalColumnTotal], 'Dim_Tiempo'[anio]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC,
	'Dim_Producto'[categoria],
	[IsDM1Total] DESC,
	'Dim_Producto'[nombre_producto],
	[ColumnIndex]

		FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Dim_Tiempo'[anio])), 'Dim_Tiempo'[anio] <> 1900)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(
				ROLLUPGROUP('Dim_Producto'[nombre_producto], 'Dim_Almacen'[nombre_almacen]), "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"
			),
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Stock_Disponible", 'Fact_Inventario'[Stock Disponible]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			502,
			__DS0Core,
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			[Stock_Disponible],
			1,
			'Dim_Producto'[nombre_producto],
			1,
			'Dim_Almacen'[nombre_almacen],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC,
	[Stock_Disponible],
	'Dim_Producto'[nombre_producto],
	'Dim_Almacen'[nombre_almacen]

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Dim_Tiempo'[anio])), 'Dim_Tiempo'[anio] <> 1900)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Dim_Tiempo'[anio],
			'Dim_Tiempo'[trimestre],
			'Dim_Tiempo'[nombre_mes],
			'Dim_Tiempo'[mes],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Stock_Disponible", 'Fact_Inventario'[Stock Disponible]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			1001,
			__DS0Core,
			'Dim_Tiempo'[anio],
			1,
			'Dim_Tiempo'[trimestre],
			1,
			'Dim_Tiempo'[mes],
			1,
			'Dim_Tiempo'[nombre_mes],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'Dim_Tiempo'[anio],
	'Dim_Tiempo'[trimestre],
	'Dim_Tiempo'[mes],
	'Dim_Tiempo'[nombre_mes]

DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
	FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Dim_Tiempo'[anio])), 'Dim_Tiempo'[anio] <> 1900)
